title: Cookies in 60 seconds
caption: Cookies in 60 seconds: how a website remembers you between requests, when HTTP itself forgets everything.

scenes.say: HTTP has no memory. Every request arrives as if from a stranger.

scenes.code:
Set-Cookie: session=8f3a9c;
  HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax

→ next request:
Cookie: session=8f3a9c
scenes.say: So the server sends a cookie, a small piece of text, and the browser sends it back on every request after.

items.title: HttpOnly
items.say: HttpOnly: page scripts can't read it.

items.title: SameSite
items.say: SameSite: limits when other sites can make the browser send it.

scenes.text:
A small note
*the browser carries for you.*
scenes.say: That's a cookie. A small note the browser carries for you.
